purpose: Apply a zero-call local citation-surface repair to D321 generation-gap model predictions before D322 shape scoring.

repair_policy.name: inline_existing_citations_only
allowed_actions: normalize citation strings such as [E2] to E2
drop citation ids not present in the source evidence pack when metadata is available
append existing citation ids inline to grounded answers
forbidden_actions: use diagnostic target answers or citations
change a grounded answer to an abstention
replace answer text with oracle/reference text

decision.next_step: Run the D322 generation-gap shape harness on repaired_predictions.jsonl. Only consider paid judging if the shape gate passes.
decision.reason: This repair only tests citation-surface headroom; it is not a grounded-correctness result.
